data.name: Nasrat
data.gender_notes: Nasrat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nasrat is derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-r' which means 'to help' or 'to aid'. In Islamic context, it is a spiritual name that signifies seeking help and support from Allah. It is also a name of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) as he relied on Allah's help throughout his life. The name Nasrat carries the meaning “Help or Assistance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasrat usually hope their child will grow to embody help or assistance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of trust and reliance on Allah's help and support.
data.etymology: Nasrat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help or Assistance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasrat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: نصرات
in_arabic.long_meaning: نصرات هي كلمة عربية تعني النصر والفوز والزحف، وهي مشتقة من الجذر نصر، الذي يرد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، ويشير إلى الانتصار والإجلال، وتستخدم هذه الكلمة في الثقافة الإسلامية للتحديد الدقيق للفوز في المعركة الروحية

in_urdu.name: نصرات
in_urdu.long_meaning: نصرات ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب فتح اور کامیابی ہے، یہ عربی gốc نصر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن پاک میں متعدد مقامات پر ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ فتح اور عظمت کی علامت ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی جنگ میں فتح کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: नस्रात

in_pashto.name: نصرت
